supersedes: configs/lora/enterprise_v2_2/sampler_v1.json (unchanged, not modified; that config and its report remain the historical record of the v1 sampler's coverage defect)
epoch_size_rule: unchanged from v1: fixed constant = n_nonGVR + floor(gvr_cap * n_nonGVR / (1 - gvr_cap)) for the frozen pool; the sampler raises if the pool no longer matches instead of changing it
correction_from_v1: v1 pinned the supplement's 240 GVR rows as always-included 'priority' items in every epoch and re-ran document water-filling from a zero count each epoch, which deterministically reselected close to the same v2.2 GVR items every time (~350 of 831 ever seen across 3 epochs). v1.1 removes the priority pin and instead lets all 1,071 v2.2+supplement GVR items compete equally for the same 496 GVR slots/epoch, filled by cross-epoch coverage-first selection (unseen items first, lowest cumulative per-document exposure among unseen, deterministic per-epoch seeded tie-break, repeats only after the whole pool is covered once).
gvr_selection: coverage_first: unseen items first (ordered by lowest cumulative per-document exposure, ties broken by sha256(seed:epoch:'gvr':sample_id)); once the pool is fully covered, repeats are drawn by the same lowest-document-exposure-first rule
validation_and_test: never sampled, reweighted, or rebalanced; evaluated at their natural v2.2 distribution, with the memory supplement reported separately (unchanged from v1)
